chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ammar ibn Marwan, from al-Munakhkhal, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, that he said:
No one is able to claim that he possesses the entire Qur'an, all of it, its outward and its inward, except the successors.

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors, i.e. the divinely appointed heirs

ai.seo_question: Who possesses complete knowledge of the Qur'an's outward and inward meanings according to Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that no one can truly claim possession of the Qur'an in its complete reality, including both its outward and inward dimensions, except the awsiya'. It emphasizes the unique religious authority and comprehensive knowledge of the divinely appointed successors regarding the Qur'an.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Al Mankhal, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘No one is able to claim that with him is the entirety of the Quran, all of it, it’s apparent, and its hidden, apart from the succesors<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn al-Husayn has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from al-Munakhkhal from Jabir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“No one is able to claim that with him is the whole of the Holy Quran; its apparent and hidden essence, except the executors of the will of the Holy Prophet (s.a.).
